title: Divisor and remainder

## Divisor and remainder

### Problem
Determine all pairs $(d, r)$ of positive integers with the property that when each of the numbers 904, 1259 and 2040 is divided by $d$, the same remainder $r$ (with $0 < r < d$) occurs.

### Solution (adapted from the official solution)
**Proof.**

### 1. Congruence

$$
\begin{cases}
904\equiv r\pmod d\\
1259\equiv r\pmod d\\
2040\equiv r\pmod d
\end{cases}
\qquad 0<r<d,\quad d,r\in\mathbb Z^+.
$$

### 2. Difference

$$
\begin{aligned}
1259-904&=355\equiv0\pmod d\\
2040-1259&=781\equiv0\pmod d
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\therefore\quad d\mid355,\qquad d\mid781.
$$

### 3. Euclidean Algorithm（辗转相除法）

$$
\begin{aligned}
781&=2(355)+71\\
355&=5(71)+0\\
\therefore\quad\gcd(355,781)&=71.
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\therefore\quad d\mid\gcd(355,781)
\implies d\mid71.
$$

Since $71$ is prime and $d>1$,

$$
\boxed{d=71}.
$$

### 4. Remainder

$$
\begin{aligned}
904&=71(12)+52\\
1259&=71(17)+52\\
2040&=71(28)+52
\end{aligned}
$$

Since $0<52<71$,

$$
\boxed{r=52}.
$$

### 5. Final Answer

$$
\boxed{(d,r)=(71,52)}
$$

$$
\therefore\quad\text{Proved.}\quad\blacksquare
$$

### Conceptual Explanation
When numbers have equal remainder mod $d$, $d$ must divide their pairwise differences: $d \mid \gcd(1259 - 904, 2040 - 1259) = \gcd(355, 781) = 71$. Since 71 is prime and $d > 1$, $d = 71$. Dividing 904 by 71 gives quotient 12 and remainder 52.

### Key Technique
Equal remainder condition implies $d \mid \gcd(x - y, y - z)$; [Euclidean algorithm](#node/node-modular-arithmetic/sec-modular-arithmetic-core) on pairwise differences.
